{"consolidated_memory":"## Memory Blowup in graph/store/adjacency.rs: Three Distinct Incidents

All three incidents affected the same component (graph/store/adjacency.rs, graph engine side) with the same symptom (resident memory climbing with every batch) but different root causes and conditions. All were reproduced using the dense neighbourhood fixture.

### Incident 1: Race Condition in Lazy Initialization [2026-01-31]
- **Trigger condition**: Manifested only for tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys
- **Root cause**: Race in lazy initialization
- **Fix**: Guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- **PR**: #1324 on branch fix/memory-blowup-1
- **Outcome**: Backlog cleared 46 minutes after deploy

### Incident 2: Unguarded Concurrent Writes [2026-04-10]
- **Trigger condition**: Manifested only when two requests raced on the same key
- **Root cause**: Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- **Fix**: Wrapped both writes in one transaction
- **PR**: #5405 on branch fix/memory-blowup-2
- **Outcome**: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 23 consecutive days
- **Notes**: Stack is Rust; covering check is the module test block in graph/store/adjacency.rs

### Incident 3: Timezone-Aware Datetime Comparison [2026-08-06]
- **Trigger condition**: Manifested only for sessions arrived through the OAuth provider
- **Root cause**: Naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
- **Fix**: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- **PR**: #9633 on branch fix/memory-blowup-3
- **Outcome**: Memory settled at 273 MB instead of climbing past 5 GB

All three incidents occurred in the same corner of graph/store/adjacency.rs and benefited from context carried over from earlier related work on this component."}
